zoneInstructions.title: How Delivery Zones Work
zoneInstructions.howItWorksDesc: When a customer checks out, the system sums the cart weight (free-delivery items' weight is excluded), finds their city in your active zones, and matches the total weight against the zone's weight ranges to determine the fee. If every item in the cart has free delivery enabled, the delivery fee is £0.
zoneInstructions.step1: Give the zone a name (e.g. "London Metro", "North England")
zoneInstructions.step2: Add all cities covered by this zone (they share the same pricing)
zoneInstructions.step3: Define weight ranges with prices — each range's min must equal the previous range's max (e.g. 0–5, 5–15, 15–30). No gaps, no overlaps.
zoneInstructions.step4: Set estimated delivery days so customers know when to expect their order
zoneInstructions.rule1: Ranges must be continuous — each min must equal the previous max (e.g. 0→5, 5→15, 15→30)
zoneInstructions.rule2: Boundary: min is inclusive, max is exclusive. [0,5) and [5,15) means exactly 5kg falls in the second range
zoneInstructions.rule3: The highest range's max is inclusive — if max is 100, a 100kg order matches that range
zoneInstructions.rule4: If cart weight exceeds all ranges, the highest range's fee is charged
zoneInstructions.rule5: 1 to 20 ranges allowed per zone. Price must be ≥ 0
zoneInstructions.importExportDesc: Export all zones as JSON or Excel, edit them externally, then re-import. The system matches by zone name + country — existing zones get updated, new ones are created. Safe to re-run (idempotent).
zoneInstructions.tip1: A city can only belong to one active zone per country
zoneInstructions.tip2: Mark one zone as "Default" per country — it's the fallback when no specific zone matches
zoneInstructions.tip3: Toggle "Free Delivery" on product variants to exclude their weight from the fee calculation. Mixed carts: only non-free items' weight is counted. All items free: delivery is £0.
zoneInstructions.tip4: If a customer's city isn't in any zone and no default zone exists, the platform's flat delivery fee applies (configurable above)
zoneInstructions.tip5: Bulk buyers always pay weight-based delivery — the free delivery flag is ignored for bulk accounts. Normal/guest users benefit from free delivery items.
zoneInstructions.tip6: Strict mode only blocks checkout when NO zone matches at all — including no default zone. If a default zone is active, it catches all unlisted cities and delivery proceeds normally.
zoneInstructions.tip7: To block a specific city: deactivating its zone is not enough if a default zone exists — the default will catch it. You must either deactivate the default zone too (blocks all unlisted cities) or the system works as designed (city falls back to default pricing).
